questions.text: What are the main features of the Land Reforms Act, 1974?
questions.text_as_printed: What are the main features of the Land Reforms Act, 1974? (Average )

answer.value:
It abolished all types of tenant farming.
The farmer was allowed to establish his right over the land he was tilling
All the tenant farming land came under the ownership of the cooperative.
Those who wanted to get a right over the land and those who needed compensation had to apply through the tribunal
The decision of the tribunal was final.

questions.text: Why has the Karnataka government fixed a maximum limit on the amount of land a family can own?
questions.text_as_printed: Why has the Karnataka government fixed a maximum limit on the amount of land a family can own? (Average)

answer.value: In 1974, the maximum land limit for a family was 54 acres if it was dry land without water facilities. If there were irrigation facilities and two or more crops were grown, ten to eighteen acres were fixed for each family, and if it was irrigated land with one crop, a maximum of 27 acres was fixed for a family.
